import sys
import heapq

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    arr = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    k = n // 2 + 1
    smallest = heapq.nsmallest(k, arr)
    median = smallest[-1]
    print(median)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
